card.title: Nintendo Switch Right Joycon pressing buttons randomly Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch Right Joycon pressing buttons randomly Repair

symptoms: right Joy-Con presses buttons by itself

claims.statement: A right Joy-Con ghost-pressing is often a faulty R button: reflow, replace, or jumper it; also make sure no flux or wet alcohol is inside the button.

procedure: Reflow or replace the R button; jumper if needed.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
